brief_rationale: The doctor correctly identified a time-sensitive trauma emergency (RC1) and provided appropriate transfer precautions and fasting instructions (RC4, RC5), but failed to actionize deterioration red flags during transfer (RC2) and did not provide a concrete handoff plan with responsible service (RC3). Two minor responsibility-chain errors (RC2, RC3) cap the grade at 2. The trajectory ended prematurely due to a runtime error before essential information handoff could be completed.

citations.explanation: Doctor gave transfer instructions and told family to call 120, but did not obtain receipt confirmation or complete essential information handoff before trajectory terminated

closure_assessment.explanation: Premature termination due to runtime error after one doctor turn. While initial guidance was provided, the doctor did not obtain family confirmation, complete essential information gathering, or establish a verifiable handoff pathway. Critical safety elements (RC2, RC3) were incomplete.
closure_assessment.label: premature_closure

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO1 requires actively repairing privacy barrier and obtaining medical-only disclosure. Doctor acknowledged privacy concern briefly but did not actively elicit medically necessary mechanism details or obtain teach-back about what to tell receiving team beyond generic instruction

HO2 requires querying workspace or targeted clarification to discover hidden facts. Doctor did not use clinical_workspace.query tool despite fragmented outside-hospital information and available records
HO3 requires creating executable transition checklist with contingencies for missing records. Doctor gave general advice to bring information but not a structured handoff packet or contingency plan
HO4 requires identifying and correcting specific misconception. Family did not express clear minimization of injury in observable dialogue; no specific misconception was surfaced to correct

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain quality defect beyond the responsibility-chain errors already identified. The trajectory was cut short by runtime error before additional defects could manifest.
